description: Source code for Bluetooth TMAP BAP broadcast sink implementation in Zephyr OS, managing scanning, synchronization, and streaming of broadcast audio.

methods.name: stream_started_cb
methods.description: Callback invoked when a stream starts, logs the event.

methods.name: stream_stopped_cb
methods.description: Callback invoked when a stream stops, logs the reason.

methods.name: stream_recv_cb
methods.description: Callback invoked when data is received on a stream, counts and logs packets.

methods.name: interval_to_sync_timeout
methods.description: Converts advertising interval to sync timeout value.

methods.name: sync_broadcast_pa
methods.description: Creates synchronization to broadcast periodic advertising.

methods.name: scan_check_and_sync_broadcast
methods.description: Checks advertisement data for broadcast UUIDs and initiates sync if found.

methods.name: broadcast_scan_recv
methods.description: Handles received scan data, filters and initiates sync.

methods.name: syncable_cb
methods.description: Callback for syncable event, signals semaphore.

methods.name: base_recv_cb
methods.description: Callback for base received event, signals semaphore.

methods.name: broadcast_pa_synced
methods.description: Handles successful sync event, signals semaphore.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the broadcast sink and semaphores.

methods.name: bap_broadcast_sink_init
methods.description: Initializes the broadcast sink, registers callbacks and capabilities.

methods.name: bap_broadcast_sink_run
methods.description: Main loop to scan, sync, and manage broadcast sink.
